data.one_liner: Optimizely feature experimentation, A/B testing and rollouts SDK for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The Optimizely Flutter SDK allows developers to integrate feature flags, A/B testing, and remote configuration into Flutter applications. It enables client initialization, user context creation, and flag decision evaluations.
use_when: You need to run A/B tests or feature experiments in your Flutter application.
You want to roll out or roll back features remotely without code deploys.
avoid_when: You only need simple local state management without remote feature flagging.
Your target iOS platform is older than version 15.0.
strengths: Enables safe feature rollouts and remote A/B testing.
Supports user attributes for targeting and results segmentation.
weaknesses: Requires iOS 15.0 and minimum Android SDK version 21.
CocoaPods is not supported on iOS (requires Swift Package Manager).
data.setup_notes: Requires an Optimizely SDK key. On iOS, requires Swift Package Manager and deployment target 15.0 or higher. On Android, requires a minimum SDK version of 21 and compile SDK version 35.
